title: Looking through old market glass
titleZh: 透過老市場的玻璃看一看
passage: Stop at the two glass panels beside the model of the market. The left panel came from one of the oldest stalls. The right one replaced a broken panel when the stall was enlarged. Both were used in the market. Look through each panel at the black stripe behind it. There’s only one stripe. If it looks bent through the older panel, you’re seeing the effect of the uneven glass, not a stripe that was drawn crooked. Stand at the brass marker to compare the panels. From there, the reflector lights the stripe evenly through both panels. Before you move on, look for the little bubbles near the left edge. Those were visible in photos taken long before the roof was repaired.
passageZh: 請在市場模型旁的兩片玻璃前停一下。左邊那片來自市場最早的一批攤位。攤位擴建時，右邊那片用來替換破掉的玻璃。兩片都曾在市場使用。 請分別透過兩片玻璃，看後方的黑色條紋。後面只有一條。如果透過較舊的玻璃看起來彎曲，那是不平整的玻璃造成的，不是條紋本身畫歪了。 請站在黃銅標記處比較兩片玻璃。從那裡看，反光板的光會均勻照在兩片玻璃後方的條紋上。往下一站前，不妨找找靠左邊緣的小氣泡。屋頂修繕很久以前拍的照片就已看得見那些氣泡。
